name: What is the design-build process for whole home remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is the design-build process for whole home remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The design-build process integrates design and construction services under a single contract with one entity, which is the design-build firm. This approach streamlines communication and responsibility, as the contractor is responsible for both the architectural plans and the physical construction. It often leads to a more efficient project timeline, better cost control, and a more cohesive vision from concept to completion. The design-build firm will manage architects, designers, and construction teams collaboratively from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design-build integrates design and construction under one contract, streamlining communication, cost control, and project execution.
